caption: The drawing depicts a wooden arched door set into a rectangular stone or stucco wall. The door consists of three vertical wooden panels, each with brown coloring, and features three wavy red vertical lines running down its length. There is a round door handle positioned near the bottom center of the door. The surrounding wall is rendered with light grey, off-white, and light brown shades to suggest texture and depth. The floor in front of the door is composed of reddish-brown rectangular tiles, arranged in a regular grid pattern. The overall composition is centered on the door and its immediate architectural surroundings, and there is a small annotation or signature in the lower right corner of the image. The background is otherwise plain and unadorned.
title: Door, Facade of Mission House
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
